meta.strictSingleEntryDefinition: A tournament is marked confirmed only when an official source clearly limits a player to one total paid entry for that event, with no re-entry, re-buy, later-flight re-entry, or equivalent extra-entry path. A one-day label or silence about re-entry is not proof.

summary.headline: No strict single-entry tournament in the reviewed Dec 13–20, 2026 schedule is confirmed by published official terms.
summary.caveat: This means none were verified in the reviewed official sources, not that none exist. Ask the tournament room for written, event-specific terms before traveling or registering.

meta.researchScope: A source-reviewed subset of in-window event listings, not a complete Las Vegas or WPT festival calendar.

researchNotes.title: No 8:00 a.m. event verified
researchNotes.body: No reviewed official schedule lists an 8:00 a.m. tournament in the working Dec 13–20 window. The earliest recently reviewed Venetian start is a 9:10 a.m. $260 satellite on Dec 12, outside the window.

researchNotes.title: WPT festival is not fully enumerated here
researchNotes.body: WPT describes the Nov 27–Dec 21 festival as having more than 85 tournaments. This record includes a subset of headline events and side events whose event-specific terms were reviewed; it is not a full festival schedule. Check the official schedule for the complete slate and later revisions. The World Championship detail page states a four-entry maximum: one per starting flight plus one Day 2 entry.

researchNotes.title: ARIA and Horseshoe need direct confirmation
researchNotes.body: ARIA's current official poker page directs players to call or check @ARIAPoker; an official-hosted Poker Open PDF reviewed earlier matched 2025 weekdays, not 2026. Horseshoe's official page says six tournament times daily but the reviewed page gives no dates, buy-ins, or entry terms.

researchNotes.title: Wynn regular daily schedule is not treated as a Dec 13–20 promise
researchNotes.body: Wynn describes its regular daily tournaments as running in non-event timeframes. The WPT festival has its own published schedule; verify the current Wynn daily lineup before relying on a daily-event listing.
